Yes, the demand was too high on 16 June 2025. The plant exceeded its contract capacity of 1250.0 kW during two 15-minute intervals:

*   **08:00**: 1307.1 kW [data: get_demand]

Reflow ovens must be switched off rather than left in standby over the weekend to prevent idle energy waste, as a reflow oven in standby mode still draws 36% of its rated power [source: docs/knowledge/equipment/EQ-01_reflow_oven.md#EQ-01 Reflow Oven Manual > Energy-saving notes]. This is noted as the largest single source of idle energy over the weekend [source: docs/knowledge/sop/SOP-02_weekend_shutdown.md#SOP-02 Weekend Shutdown > Purpose].
